sub3027: Woke up from what felt like a dream.
Looked around and saw a bird.
The main character (I) whistles back and forth with the bird
He tells the you about Heart Kingdom and Duchard, and
that we should go to Duchard before Heart Kingdom.
So he takes you to Duchard.
In Duchard you meet an old man.
The old man then proceeds to tell you that you are the heir to Heart Kingdom.
sub3042: The story that I read started by describing a complete back scene which faded into a man's dream
in which he saw himself at a place where he was about to dine with two other people
but suddenly woke up.
Upon waking up, he found himself sleeping in a complete strange bush, and
while he was still lying there a bird sat on his chest.
He looked all around trying to familiarize himself to this environment and
in the process the bird flew off of his chest
but came back again to sit on the same place.
The bird started talking and asking his name
but the man remembered himself as a professor.
He asked the bird about the place he was at and
the bird, realizing that he must have some dementia or forgetfulness illness, assisted the man with information.
He described the place they were at to be the woods near a village called Duchene which is ruled by a beautiful duchess.
He mentioned that the village was a 20 minute walk from the woods they were in.
The man, still puzzled by the talking bird, ask how it is possible that a bird can talk.
The bird explained that in the place they were in there are many different animals which could talk.
However, there are some that can't talk, so some of the animals that can talk choose not to talk, while some that can't try to talk.
The bird also encouraged the man to go to the Duchenne village which was ruled by the beautiful Duchess because he would find some kindness there
as the Duchess was kind and never allowed any intolerance in her village.
He gave directions to the man and
as they were walking and talking he made mention of another place ruled by an unkind fat cow who gets everyone he doesn't arrested.
The man and bird walk on and
it was after some time that the man realised he was out of the woods and alone.
He proceeded, and it was not long until he saw a village.
It was already very dark when he reached the village so most of the homes had their lights turned off except for one house
which is where he went to knock on.
An old man's voice answered and
opened the door.
The old man did not say anything to him but stared at the man.
He asked if he could go in and
the old man simply opened the way for him to get in the house.
The man went to sit beside the fire and
he started thanking the old man for his kindness
but still the old man did not say a word and instead continued to stare at the man uncomfortably.
After some time the man was annoyed by the stare and
raised his voice to ask why the old man was staring at him.
Excitedly, the old man told the man that he knew he could recognise his face and
went on to explain that he is an heir to a throne.
He then explained that he is a big fan of the royal throne and
that he is happy to see that the man woke up.
As he was talking, memories began to flash on the man's mind and
he was remembering some names but wondered what they meant or who they belonged to.
His stomach began to growl so the old man offered him tea and fresh jam.
He also offered him his bed
but the man refused to sleep on the old man's bed and
instead slept on his rocking chair which the old man was sitting on all along.
